# ASHA (American Speech-Language-Hearing Association)

> ASHA is the professional organization for 241,000 speech-language pathologists, audiologists, and related professionals, offering certification, continuing education, career resources, and practice management support.

ASHA serves as the credentialing body and professional hub for communication sciences and disorders professionals, providing certification standards (CCC-A, CCC-SLP, C-AA, C-SLPA), continuing education, research resources, and advocacy. The site supports multiple stakeholder groups including practitioners, students, academics, and the general public.

## Key Topics

- Speech-Language Pathology (SLP)
- Audiology
- Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC)
- Continuing Education (CE)
- ASHA Certification
- Professional Development
- Practice Management
- ASHA Membership
- Clinical Resources
- Career Development
- Speech-Language Pathologists
- Audiologists

- ASHA Learning Pass
- Assistants Certification (C-AA, C-SLPA)

## Organization & Membership

- [American Speech-Language-Hearing Association | ASHA](https://prep.asha.org): ASHA homepage with 241,000 members and main services overview
- [About the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association (ASHA)](https://prep.asha.org/about): ASHA organization overview defining mission and membership
- [ASHA Membership Information, Benefits, and Resources](https://prep.asha.org/members): Member benefits, resources, and professional community engagement
- [Join ASHA](https://prep.asha.org/members/join-asha): ASHA membership types, benefits, and certification requirements
- [ASHA Member Benefits](https://prep.asha.org/members/benefits): Detailed member benefits including journals and continuing education

## Certification & Professional Standards

- [Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology Certification](https://prep.asha.org/certification): ASHA CCC-A and CCC-SLP certification information and standards
- [Benefits of ASHA Certification in Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology](https://prep.asha.org/certification/cert_benefits): CCC certification benefits and career advancement information
- [ASHA Assistants Program](https://prep.asha.org/assistants-certification-program): C-AA and C-SLPA certifications for audiology and SLP assistants

## Continuing Education & Professional Development

- [ASHA Continuing Education](https://prep.asha.org/ce): ASHA CE registry with approved providers and CEU tracking
- [Conferences and Events](https://prep.asha.org/events): ASHA conventions and continuing education events nationwide
- [Publications of the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association (ASHA)](https://prep.asha.org/publications): ASHA journals, ASHA Leader, and scholarly publications access

## Career & Practice Resources

- [Speech-Language Pathology (SLP) Jobs, Audiology Jobs, and Career Information](https://prep.asha.org/careers): SLP and audiology job search, career portal, and salary information
- [Information for Speech-Language Pathologists (SLPs)](https://prep.asha.org/slp): SLP-specific resources and practice setting guidance
- [Information for Audiologists](https://prep.asha.org/aud): Audiology-specific resources and practice management information
- [Practice Management for Audiologists and Speech-Language Pathologists](https://prep.asha.org/practice): Billing, reimbursement, ethics, and practice management resources

## Research & Evidence-Based Practice

- [Research in Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology](https://prep.asha.org/research): Research grants, NOMS outcomes measurement, and evidence maps

## Education & Student Resources

- [Information for Academic Programs & Faculty](https://prep.asha.org/academic): CSD education resources, EdFind, and faculty support programs
- [Information for Students Interested in Communication Sciences and Disorders](https://prep.asha.org/students): Student career guidance and CSD profession information

## Advocacy & Public Resources

- [Advocacy](https://prep.asha.org/advocacy): ASHA state and federal advocacy activities and policy engagement
- [Speech, Language, Swallowing, and Hearing Information and Resources](https://prep.asha.org/public): Public patient education and professional directory resources
